summary: Testing completed for Feature 5 (AI Health Assistant with Gemini), Feature 9 (CuraPlus Subscription Bundles), and Feature 10 (Hyperlocal Health Network). All 15 backend API tests passed. Frontend testing confirmed all three new pages load correctly with proper UI elements and functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: Health Assistant uses Gemini via emergentintegrations with EMERGENT_LLM_KEY - AI responses are working correctly
CuraPlus uses DEFAULT_PLANS fallback since /api/subscriptions/plans returns Glydex/Evara plans - this is expected behavior
Hyperlocal services use demo/seed data for Mumbai region - 10 services auto-seeded on first request
All pages have proper data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: Hyperlocal demo services auto-seeded (10 services in Mumbai/Vasai area). Health Assistant test sessions created with TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Features 5, 9, 10 fully tested. Health Assistant AI chat works with Gemini (may take 5-10s for response). CuraPlus shows 4 tiers (Free, Basic, Plus, Premium) with monthly/annual toggle. Hyperlocal shows 10 demo services with distance calculation and type filtering.

features_tested.feature: Health Assistant page (/health-assistant) loads with CuraBot welcome, health tips, and quick prompts
features_tested.details: Page loads with 'Hi! I'm CuraBot' welcome, 4 health tips (Nutrition, Hydration, Exercise, Sleep), 6 quick prompt buttons, chat input, send button, history button, new chat button

features_tested.feature: Health Assistant API: POST /api/health-assistant/chat with message returns AI reply from Gemini
features_tested.details: Returns session_id, reply (AI-generated health advice), message_count. AI response includes Indian context (kadha, turmeric milk, etc.)

features_tested.feature: Health Assistant: Clicking a quick prompt sends message and gets AI response
features_tested.details: Clicked 'What are home remedies for cold and cough?' - received detailed AI response with 6 remedies and emergency guidance

features_tested.feature: Health Assistant API: GET /api/health-assistant/tips returns 6 health tips
features_tested.details: Returns 6 tips with categories: Nutrition, Hydration, Exercise, Sleep, Mental Health, Preventive Care - each with icon and Indian context

features_tested.feature: CuraPlus page (/cura-plus) loads with subscription plans and billing toggle
features_tested.details: Page loads with 'Unlock Premium Healthcare' hero, Monthly/Annual toggle, 4 plan cards, 'Why CuraPlus?' benefits section

features_tested.feature: CuraPlus: Shows Free, Basic, Plus (popular), Premium plans with pricing
features_tested.details: CuraFree (Free), CuraBasic (Rs.99/month or Rs.999/year), CuraPlus (Rs.299/month or Rs.2999/year) with MOST POPULAR badge, CuraPremium (Rs.599/month or Rs.5999/year)

features_tested.feature: CuraPlus: Monthly/Annual billing toggle works and shows 'Save 15%' badge
features_tested.details: Toggle switches between monthly and annual pricing. 'Save 15%' badge visible on Annual button. Prices update correctly when toggled.

features_tested.feature: Hyperlocal page (/nearby) loads with search, filters, and service cards
features_tested.details: Page loads with search input, 7 filter buttons (All, Pharmacy, Clinic, Hospital, Lab, Blood Bank, Ambulance), stats section, 9 service cards

features_tested.feature: Hyperlocal API: GET /api/hyperlocal/services returns nearby health services with distances
features_tested.details: Returns services with name, type, address, phone, distance_km (calculated via haversine), rating, open_hours, emergency_available flag

features_tested.feature: Hyperlocal API: GET /api/hyperlocal/stats returns service counts by type
features_tested.details: Returns total_services: 10, pharmacies: 2, clinics: 2, hospitals: 2, labs: 2, blood_banks: 1, ambulances: 1

features_tested.feature: Hyperlocal: Filter buttons (All, Pharmacy, Clinic, Hospital, Lab, Blood Bank, Ambulance) work
features_tested.details: Clicking Pharmacy filter shows 2 pharmacies, Hospital filter shows 2 hospitals, All filter shows all 9 services

features_tested.feature: Hyperlocal: Emergency banner shows with Call 112 link
features_tested.details: 'Emergency Services Available' banner visible with '5 emergency-ready services nearby' and 'Call 112' button

features_tested.feature: Home page (/) regression check - loads correctly
features_tested.details: Nevika Cura branding visible, DiaGyn/Mango/Orange links present, all main navigation working
